comments.author: thijson
comments.why: Compares panel orientations; vertical yields about 70% of optimal
comments.text: This guy compared different orientations: [VIDEO] His conclusion is the vertical generate about 70% of optimal incline cells. The charge profile has two peaks, one in the morning, one in the evening. I can imagine using the vertical orientation for a fence. It would definitely keep them cleaner too.

comments.author: pests
comments.why: Evidence that vertical panels can be more efficient
comments.text: There is research coming out that vertical solar panels are more efficient. I think part of it comes from lower temps allowing for more efficient operating. No tracking or pointing required. Less cleaning as its not a flat surface for dust or fall impacts. [VIDEO] edit: I see others have linked similar videos, all good sources on this topic.
